### 🤖 Jarvis Intelligence & Capability Matrix

**🎵 Smart Curation & Mood Steering**
• `play something chill` | `play something melancholic` | `play energetic workout mix` — DSP-backed acoustic mood steering

• `how big is my library?` | `what are my top genres?` | `my most played tracks` — Quantitative statistics

• `search Qobuz for [Query]` | `search online for [Track]` — Cloud search

**💬 Natural Conversation & Context Memory**
• Pronoun tracking: `play their top songs`, `queue that album`, `play it again`
